Branch Manager Job at Prodigy HR Solutions




        
    

        
        Prodigy HR Solutions - Our client is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Branch Manager
Job Location: Kano

	We are seeking a competent, results-driven, and experienced professional to fill the position of Branch Manager in Kano State, Nigeria.
	The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership, managerial, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to oversee branch operations, lead a team, drive business growth, and ensure excellent service delivery.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Marketing & Sales Officer",
  "description": "KeepAlive Ambulance - We are an asset-light, real-time emergency logistics platform designed explicitly for the unique realities of the Nigerian landscape. We don&#39;t own ambulances; instead, we do something much more powerful: we bridge the gap.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Marketing &amp; Sales Officer

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are looking for a results-driven Marketing &amp; Sales Officer to identify new business opportunities, generate qualified leads, build client relationships, and contribute to business growth.
	The successful candidate will work closely with the Head of Marketing to turn prospects into customers through effective sales, marketing, and field engagement.


Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities and generate qualified leads.
	Prepare proposals, presentations, and sales pitches for prospective clients.
	Engage prospects, attend client meetings, and follow up on sales opportunities.
	Execute digital and offline marketing campaigns, including field visits and market activations.
	Track leads, maintain accurate sales records, and follow up consistently.
	Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities for repeat business and referrals.
	Monitor market trends, campaign performance, and sales results, and prepare regular reports.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
	3&ndash;6 years of experience in marketing, sales, business development, or a combination of these areas.
	Demonstrable experience in lead generation, client engagement, and field marketing.
	Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
	Ability to prepare proposals and client-facing presentations.
	Familiarity with CRM systems, lead tracking, and digital marketing tools.
	A proactive, organised, and results-oriented approach to work.
	Willingness to travel within Lagos and its environs for client meetings and field activities.


Salary
N150,000 - N300,000 monthly, depending on experience

Method of Application
Interested and qualified applicants should send their Applications to: admin@keepaliveambulance.com using &quot;Marketing &amp; Sales Officer &ndash; [Your Name]&quot; as the subject of the email.",

	We are looking for a results-driven Marketing & Sales Officer to identify new business opportunities, generate qualified leads, build client relationships, and contribute to business growth.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Admin Manager",
  "description": "Dexterous Applied Training Institute (DATI) is a leading consultancy, training, and development institute, certified across multiple industries in which we operate. We are dedicated to supporting Public and Private Organizations, Oil &amp; Gas companies and their host communities, Manufacturing and Production firms, Energy providers, Hospitality businesses, and Educational institutions.

Our mission is to bridge skills gaps, provide expert guidance on emerging upskilling needs, and develop human resource capacity in line with global best practices and standards. By aligning workforce development with organizational goals and facilitating technology transfer, we help institutions achieve sustainable growth and long-term competitiveness.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Admin Manager

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers State (with oversight across Lagos and Warri branches)
Employment Type: Full-time
Schedule: Monday &ndash; Friday, 7:30 AM &ndash; 5:00 PM (Occasional travel required)
Reporting To: Chief Training Officer
Grade Band: Grade 8 (AMIII)

About the Role


	We are seeking an experienced, high-performing Admin Manager to provide strategic and operational administrative leadership across our regional centres (Port Harcourt, Lagos, and Warri).
	You will be responsible for streamlining operational workflows, enforcing institutional SOPs, driving multi-site vendor and procurement performance, overseeing fleet and facility maintenance, and providing end-to-end administrative support for our technical training operations and corporate logistics.


Key Responsibilities


	Multi-Site Administrative Leadership: Direct day-to-day administrative operations, facilities management, and regional team supervision across Port Harcourt, Lagos, and Warri branches.
	Vendor &amp; Procurement Management: Lead vendor selection, negotiate contracts, enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and execute cost-effective office procurement and inventory controls.
	Training Operations Support: Oversee trainee registration documentation, attendance administration, feedback tracking, and the production, acquisition, and distribution of course materials.
	Logistics &amp; Fleet Administration: Manage corporate fleet operations, vehicle maintenance schedules, fuel utilization, executive travel, flight/hotel bookings, and corporate hospitality.
	Policy, SOPs &amp; Governance: Formulate and rollout departmental SOPs, enforce organizational compliance, maintain security protocols, and coordinate internal/external communications.


Qualifications &amp; Key Requirements


	Education: Minimum of a B.Sc. or HND in Business Administration, Public Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field. Relevant technical/management certifications are an added advantage.
	Experience: 5&ndash;7 years of progressive corporate administration experience, including at least 2 years in a managerial or team-lead capacity.
	Core Skills: Multi-site team supervision, SLA drafting &amp; vendor scorecards, facility oversight, SOP development, corporate protocol, meeting governance, and training logistics.
	Technical Skills: Proficient in use of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)


What We Look For:


	A leader who leads with influence and not Authority
	Hands on leader, who leads and implement from the front
	Strategic thinkers capable of balancing macro planning with multi-site execution.
	Proven leadership and accountability in geographically dispersed teams.
	High attention to detail in procurement, compliance, and documentation.
	Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.


Salary Range
N4,600,000 &ndash; N5,600,000 annually.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their updated CV to personnel@dexterousinstitute.com with &quot;ADMIN MANAGER&quot; as the subject of the email.

 Job Position: Admin Manager

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers State (with oversight across Lagos and Warri branches)
Employment Type: Full-time
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:30 AM – 5:00 PM (Occasional travel required)
Reporting To: Chief Training Officer
Grade Band: Grade 8 (AMIII)

About the Role


	We are seeking an experienced, high-performing Admin Manager to provide strategic and operational administrative leadership across our regional centres (Port Harcourt, Lagos, and Warri).
	You will be responsible for streamlining operational workflows, enforcing institutional SOPs, driving multi-site vendor and procurement performance, overseeing fleet and facility maintenance, and providing end-to-end administrative support for our technical training operations and corporate logistics.


Key Responsibilities


	Multi-Site Administrative Leadership: Direct day-to-day administrative operations, facilities management, and regional team supervision across Port Harcourt, Lagos, and Warri branches.
	Vendor & Procurement Management: Lead vendor selection, negotiate contracts, enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and execute cost-effective office procurement and inventory controls.
	Training Operations Support: Oversee trainee registration documentation, attendance administration, feedback tracking, and the production, acquisition, and distribution of course materials.
	Logistics & Fleet Administration: Manage corporate fleet operations, vehicle maintenance schedules, fuel utilization, executive travel, flight/hotel bookings, and corporate hospitality.
	Policy, SOPs & Governance: Formulate and rollout departmental SOPs, enforce organizational compliance, maintain security protocols, and coordinate internal/external communications.


Qualifications & Key Requirements


	Education: Minimum of a B.Sc. or HND in Business Administration, Public Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field. Relevant technical/management certifications are an added advantage.
	Experience: 5–7 years of progressive corporate administration experience, including at least 2 years in a managerial or team-lead capacity.
	Core Skills: Multi-site team supervision, SLA drafting & vendor scorecards, facility oversight, SOP development, corporate protocol, meeting governance, and training logistics.
	Technical Skills: Proficient in use of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)


What We Look For:


	A leader who leads with influence and not Authority
	Hands on leader, who leads and implement from the front
	Strategic thinkers capable of balancing macro planning with multi-site execution.
	Proven leadership and accountability in geographically dispersed teams.
	High attention to detail in procurement, compliance, and documentation.
	Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

N4,600,000 – N5,600,000 annually.
